book.name: APOCALIPSIS
book.title: YIN̈ TZET AKꞌLAX YOHTAN̈ELO NAJ SAN JUAN YU COMAM JESUCRISTO

content: Lahwi tuꞌ, wilnihan istzilnilo Comam oc xahanbalil huneꞌ babel sello, wabenan yalni naj babel querubín yin̈ caw ip hacaꞌ isbili cꞌuh, yalni naj: —¡Cata! ẍi naj.
Hayet inhacxitojan wilnihan huneꞌ noꞌ cheh sajin̈ ayato huneꞌ naj yiban̈ noꞌ, ikꞌbil xin huneꞌ teꞌ litꞌ yu naj, yakꞌlax huneꞌ corona tet naj. Isto naj yin̈ howal, chilann̈eticꞌa xin iskꞌoji naj.
Haxa yet istzilnilo Comam oc xahanbalil iscab sello, wabenan yalni naj iscab querubín: —¡Cata! ẍi naj.
Wilnipaxojan huneꞌ noꞌ cheh cajin̈, yakꞌlax yip naj ayahto yiban̈ noꞌ yinilo akꞌancꞌulal yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ. Yun̈e yoc anma ispotxꞌleno isba; yakꞌlax huneꞌ niman espada tet naj.

Haxa yet istzilnilo Comam oc xahanbalil isyox sello, wabenan yalni naj yox querubín hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¡Cata! ẍi naj. Wilnihan huneꞌ noꞌ cheh kꞌejin̈, haꞌ naj ayahto yiban̈ noꞌ ikꞌbil huneꞌ chꞌen libra malbal yu naj.
Xol ebnaj can̈wan̈ querubín tuꞌ wabenan huneꞌ yul nukꞌe halni: —Cabn̈e libra trigo maca wajeb libra cebada chikꞌ naj munlawom yin̈ tzꞌayic. Mach xin cheyetato teꞌ aceite yeb teꞌ vino, ẍi.
Haxa yet istzilnilo Comam oc xahanbalil iscan̈ sello, wabenan yalni naj iscan̈ querubín: —¡Cata! ẍi naj.

Wilnipaxojan huneꞌ noꞌ cheh kꞌanin̈, haꞌ xin naj ayahto yiban̈ noꞌ, camical isbi naj, yinta naj xin tzujan naj yahawil bay ay camom. Yakꞌlax yip ebnaj istan̈tzenilo huneꞌ iscan̈ majan anma ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ yu ej howal, wahil, yebej yabil yebpaxo yu ej noꞌ howla nokꞌ ay sat txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ tiꞌ.

Haxa yet istzilnilo Comam oc xahanbalil ishoꞌ sello, wilnihan huneꞌ meẍa bay chakꞌlax xahanbal, yalan̈ huneꞌ meẍa tuꞌ wilan yanma ebnaj potxꞌbil camo yu yalnicꞌo Istzotiꞌ Comam Dios, yeb yu yakꞌ isba ebnaj testigohal yin̈.

Chalni ebnaj yin̈ caw ip: —Mam Jahawil, Mam mach istxꞌojal ayco tawin̈, wal xin isyelaln̈eticꞌa chawala. ¿Bakꞌin chawil yin̈ tzet chꞌelico anma ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal cat hawakꞌni ispaj tet mac con̈potxꞌnicamojan̈? ẍi.

Yakꞌlax huntekꞌan xil iskꞌap ebnaj caw saj jilni, yallax tet ebnaj ta chi-to-xew ebnaj hanicꞌoxa tiempo masanto chitzꞌajna isbisil ebnaj juẍta yilal yakꞌlax camoj, yu chakꞌ chejaꞌ isba tet Comam Cristo.
Haxa yet istzilnilo Comam oc xahanbalil iswaj sello, yecꞌ huneꞌ nimam chixcab, iskꞌejholilo tzꞌayic hacaꞌ hunu kꞌap kꞌap kꞌej, iscajpon̈ilo ixahaw hacaꞌ chicꞌ.
Yaycꞌayejti txꞌumel satcan̈ hacaꞌ yay hona sat teꞌ higuera yu hunu niman jakꞌekꞌ yet yaxto teꞌ.
Iscꞌaycan̈ satcan̈, hacaꞌ chu ischullaxayo hunu xaj hum. Sunil witz yebej txꞌo txꞌotxꞌ ay xol haꞌ mar isheqꞌuilo isba yul yehobal.

Sunil ebnaj rey yul yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ yeb ebnaj winaj caw ay yelapnoj, yeb ebnaj kꞌalom, yeb ebnaj yahawil soldado, yeb ebnaj caw aycano yip, yeb ebnaj chejab, yeb ebnaj yet isba ischuquil, yebato isba ebnaj yulaj n̈achꞌen yeb yichla chꞌen chꞌen ay iswiꞌla witz.
Chalni ebnaj tet ej witz yeb tet chꞌen nimeta chꞌen hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¡Titan̈we wuyna jiban̈an̈, cat con̈heyebantojan̈ yin̈ sat Comam tzꞌon̈an yul yehobal, yeb tet ishowal Comam oc xahanbalil,
yuto mahul istzꞌayical bay chihul isyaꞌtajil yu Comam Dios, mach xin mac chikꞌoji istecha huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil tiꞌ yu! ẍi ebnaj.
